blacklist.description: List of kernel modules to prevent from auto-loading (e.g., to avoid driver conflicts)

module.description: Name of the kernel module to blacklist (e.g., 'snd_hda_intel')

modprobe_options.description: Module-specific runtime parameters (e.g., card ordering, quirks, power settings)

params.description: List of parameter assignments (e.g., ['power_save=0', 'index=1'] → options module power_save=0 index=1)

pcm_default.description: Default PCM device name (format: 'hw:<card>,<device>') used by applications without explicit device selection

card_default.description: Default sound card index or name (e.g., '0', 'Generic' for ALSA mixer apps)

latency_us.description: Target audio latency in microseconds (e.g., 20000 = 20 ms). Set to null to skip custom PCM latency settings

power_save.description: Enable/disable audio power save (0 = disabled, 10 = auto-suspend after 10 sec). Set to null to skip module-level power_save setting
